title: EEGPT: Pretrained Transformer for Universal and Reliable Representation of EEG Signals
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict whether a matrix-speller stimulus contains the attended character from its EEG event epoch. Current scope is the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 panel, including all source subjects, EEGPT and original BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM controls, and all three reported metrics.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict whether a matrix-speller stimulus contains the attended character from its EEG event epoch. Current scope is the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 panel, including all source subjects, EEGPT and original BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM controls, and all three reported metrics.

Source-paper comparison for PhysioP300 Table 4 AUROC with complete source comparison panel and BAC/Cohen kappa reporting: Primary source component metric is AUROC, higher better: probability that a target event receives a higher class-1 score than a nontarget, with half credit for ties. Probe concatenates all validation-epoch scores before binary metrics. Report BAC and Cohen kappa too; single-class support cannot be silently accepted as a valid AUROC.
success_criteria: Evaluate the complete original PhysioP300 Table 4 task: all source subjects under LOSO, original EEGPT and BENDR/BIOT/LaBraM control conditions, and AUROC/BAC/Cohen kappa reporting. Unrelated S8 downstream tasks are not prerequisites for this selected panel win.

Resolve subject/recording/event support, epoch boundaries, scoring reduction, checkpoint and exposure protocol. Establish author-baseline calibration on the original population; protocol-equivalent stochastic reruns with recorded new seeds and justified calibration tolerance are valid.

Freeze candidate procedure, preprocessing and selection before final scoring; use training/development feedback during iteration, disclose historical public-test exposure, and pair candidate/reference comparisons on the same evaluated support.

Exceed the source EEGPT result under the original task with a justified predeclared effect and valid paired uncertainty rule, while retaining the complete source panel and reporting all original metrics and failures.

Keep changed preprocessing without source-parity evidence, new split rules, reduced cohorts and new adaptation regimes as separately labelled extensions. Local controls and successful reproduction alone cannot substitute for the published comparison.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
